review_repair.result: Expected E0599 failures before repair: no recoverable completion route error API and no explicit retired-request outcome after eviction.

tests.component: 22 passed: twenty public component cases and two revision-exhaustion unit boundaries
tests.fast_result: 1/1 CTest target passed in 2.41 seconds; the target runs all 22 session tests
tests.boundary_result: The full gate includes absent-JUCE/browser/UI source build, both C++ FFI/callback checks, dynamic CLAP host and isolated CLAP build boundary
tests.signed_oracle: The recovered accepted edit renders literal stereo -0.5 at MIDI 60 and silence at 36; its history length is exactly one and an independent session retains literal -0.5 at MIDI 36

coverage.classification: The four zero-count items are generic-instantiation spans in LLVM's per-monomorph accounting. The retained annotated report shows executed merged counters for every source line and execution of invalid/retired attachment, invalid instance/job, conflict, pending, busy, stale/retired request, preparation failure, staging failure, activation failure and accepted branches.

request_evidence.owned_job: MappingJob is statically Send and owns accepted YAML, preparation context, render settings, request identity/revision and typed intent; its test moves preparation to another thread after detaching the admitting attachment.
request_evidence.single_pending: A same-content retry reports pending; conflicting ID reuse, a second request, direct preparation, direct commit, undo and redo reject while the admitted job owns the slot.
request_evidence.lost_acknowledgement: Completion succeeds after attachment retirement. A fresh attachment queries and retries the same request, receives the same Arc outcome, observes revision 1/history length 1 and does not reactivate.
request_evidence.terminal_failures: Missing-sample preparation, revision exhaustion and host activation rejection are retained terminal outcomes; exact retry does not prepare or activate again and the pending slot admits later work.
request_evidence.bounded_outcomes: After 129 terminal failures at one accepted revision, request 0 is absent while requests 1 and 128 remain. After the missing sample is restored, exact and conflicting reuse of evicted request 0 receive RetiredRequest without preparation, activation or state change.
request_evidence.independence: Cross-instance requests reject without mutation. A misrouted completion returns its owned prepared result, leaves the second session unchanged and then completes successfully at the still-pending source session.

allocation_boundary.success: The accepted RequestOutcome Arc and its returned reference are created before activation. The outcome deque is preallocated to 128; post-install retention at capacity pops then pushes without fallible allocation.
allocation_boundary.failure: Preparation, staging and activation failures occur before accepted installation and may allocate their retained diagnostic afterward.

specification.sync: No new canonical scenario is synchronized because the proposed scenario also requires later concrete native host/editor proof.

limits: This is an in-process protocol boundary over the real Rust graph; task 3.1 must calibrate worker completion, installation, rollback and held-reader behavior at the actual native consumer.
The journal is not yet capped at 100 entries and external accepted-document replacement is not implemented; task 2.3 remains open even though the outcome deque already enforces its exact 128 limit.
Wire attachment/request identities and lossless decimal representation are deferred to task 3.2.
No React transport, actual WebView destruction, VST3/standalone packaging, named DAW proof or full beta claim is made.
Main remains unchanged and no merge is included.
